implementation.present: The named bounded tool/authority is present; no broad readiness or option-parity claim.
implementation.partial: A bounded subset exists, or material options/workflow gates remain open.
implementation.missing: No user-facing implementation found for this named tool; a placeholder or different related command is insufficient.

nativeEvidence.qualified: Exact named native scope qualified in cited receipt; never broad physical or platform parity.
nativeEvidence.partial: Cited native/Qt/API evidence is bounded or excludes material ordinary/physical/platform workflow.
nativeEvidence.unknown: No native acceptance receipt identified for this row. Source/core evidence alone cannot qualify it.

scope.proposed-v1: Proposed required shape-creation/print scope for review; breadth includes currently missing tools.
scope.experimental: Available bounded optional capability; do not use it to imply general assembly coverage.
scope.later: Explicit long-term family outside the proposed first printable-shape release.
scope.infrastructure: Agent/test/control support, not an independent end-user CAD tool.

provenance.discovery: Static source extraction of literal registry calls plus explicit expansion of nonliteral registry loops, cross-checked against the root-owned accepted build commands.list export. semanticDispatchers.sketch.tool: 24 enum values are listed on sketch.interaction; these are tool modes, not 24 extra registered command IDs.

runtimeCrossCheck.source: Root-owned accepted-build commands.list export; editor closed after export. No modeling or input validation performed by this worker.
